title: Nadab and Abihu Die for Offering Strange Fire
description: Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu offer strange fire before the Lord, which He had not commanded them. Fire comes out from the Lord and consumes them. Moses reminds Aaron that the Lord must be held holy, and calls Mishael and Elzaphan to carry the dead out of the camp. Aaron and his surviving sons Eleazar and Ithamar are forbidden to mourn openly.
